title: End-to-end canonical feature conveyor authority
description: Language-neutral authority for constructing, projecting, executing, and reviewing one canonical feature in causal conveyor order.

const: request contract bytes are consumed and hashed
semantic plan covers every scenario in order
at least one governed implementation artifact is materialized
every scenario body is materialized at scenarios/{scenarioId}/{responsibilityId}/{responsibilityId}.mjs
the only runtime entrypoint is runtime/invokes-{featureId}.mjs
alternate bin, lib, src, helper, and test implementation topologies are rejected
materialized artifact hashes remain unchanged during acceptance

const.stepInputBehavior: select operation input without rebasing the evaluation document

const.semantics: resolve the declared observation through the fixture and evidence ports and assign it at the declared path
evaluate rules in declaration order and select exactly the first matching rule
resolve each declared path or literal field without implicit fields and assign the canonical result
the resolved left array contains no JCS-equal right value
resolved evidence payloads have equal JCS bytes
the resolved evidence payload disposition equals the literal right operand
